children: in final funding to complete a fully financed C$1.3B construction package for its 100%-owned, fully permitted Marathon copper-palladium project in Ontario.
Canada Growth Fund said it committed to invest C$140M in Generation Mining

through $90M in the company's common shares as part of a broader C$200M equity financing and a C$50M convertible note as part of a C$100M offering of convertible notes to be issued by Generation on a private placement basis.
The Marathon project is expected to produce 2.1M oz of palladium, 532M lbs of copper, 488K oz of platinum, 160K of gold, and 3M oz of silver over its 13-year lifetime.
